expect: page_state ids_unreliable with the tracer reason (ids are replaced)

expected_rules.stages: users[] without alias rows, detail.set_aside false, state not unknown: grade unattended or substate overdue or held = silent; state stopped = stopped_named; every other = active; new = state new; stopped_expected = app_profile.funnel.stopped_expected. null on a refused page (funnel is null)
expected_rules.truth_is_placebo: from the simulator truth, for reading the scenario only; the judge never reads it
expected_rules.verdict: app_profile.issue_diagnostics[issue].verdict mapped to the plan codes; no diagnostics: page_refused on a refused page, else too_few_ids (no hit id can be compared)

files.expected.json: reference output: page state, reason, tracer, stage counts, per issue numbers and verdict code
files.hits.csv: end_user_hit rows, every role; key index empty = no user id; session_only 1 = a ref with no trace: id of the session's first trace with an id, day of its last trace, route trace counts in session_routes
files.id_days.csv.gz: end_user_day rows; see the fact contract in fold.py
files.ids.csv: end_user rows: key index (sorted id text), user_key (HMAC with salt_hex), synthetic id text, shape prefix and length, cluster text and hash, first and last day, session count, all sessions link the id
files.issues.json: issue lineages: case (or lone finding) and its findings; every one complete
files.null_days.csv.gz: end_user_day_null rows: all traces and traces with no user id per (day, route, version)
files.routes.json: route number -> name, call site, class and statistics from logic.py app_profile.routes
files.versions.csv: end_user_version rows; first trace day is the deploy day

judge_run.findings: every finding complete (hit rule: role member)
judge_run.page_state_memory: none stored (the reference has no memory)
judge_run.route_classes: from routes.json, as stored; no stored class from an earlier run, no relearning

readings: logic.py reads traces; the judge reads these facts. Session hashes and job keys are capped at 32 per row (final-plan.md 3.3 reading 2); route classes come from routes.json (reading 1 does not apply here).
Token-link test: logic.py tests the alias representative's text against the sessions of all its aliases; ids.csv gives the flag per raw id.
Session-only refs whose session has no id are listed with an empty key index; logic.py ignores them.
Alias rows in users[] are skipped in the stage counts.
Call-site text that read like a product name is renamed in the sample before logic.py runs (new names: assist_generate); logic.py and the facts see the same text.

reference.program: churn/proposals/v3/logic.py (own null in sorted draw order)
reference.switches: defaults (W1, W3, W4, W6, W7, W8, W9 on)

sample.rule: ids that share a simulated person, or are the only two ids of a session or thread, are one unit; any other session or thread, and a trace with neither, is its own unit; keep a unit when crc32('<hash_key>|u:<smallest id>') % 10000 < rate (a unit with no id: s:<session>, h:<thread> or t:<trace>)
